_howto: HOW TO ADD A VIDEO: copy the TikTok video URL, add an object to the
Optional: "pinned": true to badge + pin it to the top (keep max one per creator).
The date is encoded in the video ID if unsure: new Date(Number(BigInt(id) >> 32n) * 1000).
Thumbnails: save a ~360px webp at thumbs/<video-id>.webp (grab thumbnail_url from
https://www.tiktok.com/oembed?url=<video-url> and download it; those CDN URLs
expire, so a local copy is required). Missing thumbs fall back to a styled card.
Push to main; the site deploys automatically.
_auto: This file is auto-refreshed hourly by scripts/refresh-videos.mjs. Hand-edited "note" text is preserved by video id (an empty "" note stays empty); "views"/"pinned" are recomputed. New/removed videos and note/pinned/date changes are written on every run; view-count-only changes are written at most every 6 hours to limit deploy churn. _lastRefresh records the last successful write and per-creator fetch health.
